## Execution checkpoint — whole roadmap remains in progress

All **20 issues, 80 acceptance criteria, 41 dependency links and 5 milestones** remain in scope; dates and assignees remain unset. Six issues (#2, #3, #5, #6, #8, #11) have historical local acceptance. The other fourteen are not accepted. Draft PR #22 is not current CI, deployment, publication or merge-ready evidence.

### Read-model gate (#7)
The fifth prospective diagnostic cycle now has both complete independent reviews. The original review returned **SHIP for immutable static proposal data only**. The separate quality review returned **FIX-FIRST: two HIGH, zero CRITICAL**:
1. ACK transmission is treated as retirement authority without proof of current child acceptance; a second primary transaction can remain unacknowledged when cleanup proceeds.
2. Valid JSON-RPC errors enter the transport-failure path before the preserved `NativeError` consumer can execute, including ordinary callers.

Both reports were read in full, all 74 guarded inputs and all 198 descriptor byte identities were checked, and both actual native Done receipts were followed by release before acknowledgment. The candidate remains unchanged. **The required two-review SHIP condition is not met: no application or safe-path smoke is authorized.** Five cycles are used; no sixth cycle, new candidate or reset is authorized. Original four read-model/native-reader acceptance criteria remain BLOCKED_NOTRUN; the historical failed-response causal body remains unavailable/unknown. Evidence: `.genie/wishes/open-intelligence-observatory/verification/Source7-cap5-5-COMPLETE-bothFULL-originalSHIP-qualityFIXFIRST-twoHIGH-ACTUALDones-afterReleases-beforeACK-NOconditionalApplySmoke.json`.

### Native DSH gate (#4)
The settled DESIGN repair3/3 pair remains **SHIP for the bounded static proposal only**, not runtime acceptance. Under the owner-authorized gated implementation route, the read-only inventory worker has acquired the complete fixed-revision tree: 15,962 entries, including 14,004 blobs. Measured inventory bounds were explicitly amended before further access. Complete SDK/build/export/generated/package/license closure and bounded executable contracts are still pending. A different independent full plan review must pass before worker-owned implementation. No implementation permission was inferred from the static design verdict.

Issued principals, credential custody, spend admission, native activation and actual runtime acceptance remain separate gates. No third stock DSH attempt, fifth Brain attempt, paid model call, artificial dependency or weakened original criterion is authorized. Product model calls remain zero; coding/storage/all-in cost remains unknown. The coordinator performs orchestration and report/opaque metadata intake, not direct implementation code.

### Subsequent owner disposition — bounded sixth cycle
After the settled fifth-cycle FIX-FIRST gate, the owner explicitly authorized **one bounded sixth prospective cycle**, amending cap5→cap6 with **used5 and one remaining; no reset**. A new native source fixer has been dispatched only for the two confirmed defects within the existing three-program boundary. Its complete current 78-input before-access method and positive scope grant are still required. No source artifact access was inferred from dispatch.

Both **new** complete independent original and quality reviews must return SHIP with zero HIGH/CRITICAL before worker-owned application of the exact repaired candidate and separately qualified changed-safe-path smoke. No seventh cycle, native activation, paid call, extra subsystem or original feature waiver is authorized. The immutable fifth candidate and both opposed fifth verdicts remain preserved. The independent DSH inventory continues unchanged.
